We are looking for a proactive and reliable Integrated Marketing Executive to support and independently drive the execution of various marketing projects in Qatar. This role will work closely with internal teams, external agencies, media partners, vendors, and merchants to ensure marketing campaigns are delivered on time, on quality, and aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in campaign execution, agency coordination, production follow-up, event or offline activation, social/content projects, and day-to-day marketing operations. This person should be detail-oriented, highly organized, resilient under pressure, and able to push things forward in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. Beyond strong execution, we are also looking for someone with strategic potential — someone who is curious about consumers, understands why a campaign is being done, can summarize learnings from execution, and can gradually grow from “getting things done” to “thinking through what should be done and why.”

1. Campaign Planning, Execution and Project Follow-up
Independently plan & manage the execution of marketing campaigns and daily marketing projects, including timeline planning, task tracking, material preparation, internal coordination, and on-ground delivery. Ensure all projects are delivered on time, on quality, and in line with the campaign objectives and brand requirements.

2. Agency and Vendor Coordination
Coordinate with creative agencies, media agencies, production vendors, event suppliers, influencers/KOLs, and other external partners. Follow up on briefs, proposals, quotations, production progress, delivery timelines, and execution quality to ensure smooth project implementation.

3. Content and Creative Asset Management
Work closely with internal teams and external agencies to support the development, review, adaptation, and delivery of campaign materials, including social content, offline materials, merchant-facing assets, in-app banners, videos, event materials, and other marketing assets. Ensure all materials are accurate, localized, and consistent with brand guidelines.

4. Offline Activation and Event Support
Support the planning and execution of offline activations, brand events, merchant co-marketing activities, campus or community campaigns, and other local marketing initiatives. Coordinate logistics, venue setup, materials, staffing, vendor communication, and on-site execution details.

5. Cross-functional Coordination
Work with internal teams such as Brand, Social, CRM, BD, Operations, Product, Design, Data, and Customer Service to align project requirements, collect information, follow up on deliverables, and solve execution issues during campaign delivery.

6. Marketing Operations and Daily Support
Support day-to-day marketing operations, including campaign calendar maintenance, budget and payment follow-up, procurement process, asset organization, meeting notes, project documentation, and basic reporting.

7. Campaign Tracking and Post-campaign Summary
Track campaign execution status and collect basic performance data, user feedback, market observations, and execution learnings. Support post-campaign summaries and help identify what worked, what did not work, and what can be improved in future campaigns.

. Local Market and Consumer Observation
Stay close to local market trends, competitor activities, consumer behavior, cultural moments, and offline opportunities. Share observations and execution insights with the team to support better campaign planning and localization.

This role requires a rounded marketer who can think strategically, collaborate across functions, and adapt quickly. Core expertise must be digital marketing (paid media, social, influencer, analytics), but the ideal candidate is equally comfortable discussing brand narrative, merchant co-marketing, and user growth. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Strategy & Integration
* Define the annual digital roadmap, balancing brand-building and performance objectives.
* Lead the integration of brand campaigns with performance marketing – ensuring consistent messaging, targeting, and measurement.
* Act as the strategic bridge to the centralized performance marketing team: challenge results, guide optimizations, and ensure alignment with Keeta’s local market nuances.
2. Social Media & Influencer Leadership
* Own organic social strategy (Instagram, TikTok, X) – content pillars, community management, and follower growth.
* Lead performance-driven influencer programs (KOLs, KOCs) with clear KPIs (engagement, conversion, CPE).
* Leverage Arabic language skills to develop culturally relevant content and manage local influencer relationships.
3. Merchant Co‑marketing (Online)
* Design and execute joint online campaigns with merchant partners (co-branded ads, exclusive landing pages, in-app placements).
* Use Keeta’s digital assets (splash screens, banners, push) as part of merchant value exchange.
4. Data, Analytics & Experimentation
* Build dashboards to track key metrics (ROI, CPA, CPO, CPE, reach, engagement).
* Lead weekly reviews with performance teams, identifying inefficiencies and testing new channels/creatives.
* Foster a test‑and‑learn culture – small-budget experiments, rapid iteration.
5. Cross‑functional Collaboration
* Work closely with other marketing teams (PR, Brand, C-end, Merchant, D-end) and business functions to ensure digital initiatives support broader company goals.
6. Team & Capability Building
* Manage and mentor a small in‑house team (social, merchant coordination, analytics).
* Short‑term: Serve as the strategic interface to the centralized performance team.
* Long‑term: Build a roadmap to bring key performance marketing capabilities in‑house, increasing Keeta’s self‑sufficiency.

list.name: LongCat - 基座 Agent 评测分析算法研究员

department.name: 核心本地商业-基础研发平台

list.jobDuty:
随着AI下半场的到来，传统的评测范式已经无法适配持续提升的模型能力，针对ChatBot模型的Arena评测的有效性也遭到质疑，如何面向现阶段以及未来的模型能力进行科学有效的评估本身也是个极具挑战和价值的研究方向。OpenAI研究者也表示，AI接下来比拼的不是训练，而是“如何定义并评估真正有用的任务”。

在这样的背景下，美团大模型评测团队以指引通往AGI的道路为目标，深耕模型评测研究，系统性的理解大模型当前能力水平及未来技术发展方向，并以此为基础完善模型评测能力矩阵。团队工作方向包括但不限于：①构建科学有效的评测方案，为现阶段大模型提供有效的评测和分析手段，并面向未来模型储备评测技术，包括人机协同评测、产品化隐式评测方案、全模态交互式评测方案等；②结合训练和评测，对模型的能力进行建模及深入的理解和研究，包括能力体系构建、训练阶段分析、模型能力/问题溯源等；③探索模型能力边界，发现当前模型训练范式的局限性，寻求模型能力突破。

本岗位涉及的方向包括：

1. Agent评测构建与方案探索，包括但不限于：通用模型的Agent能力评测与探索，Computer Use、Code Agent、通用搜索等产品级Agent的评测方案和分析。

2. 长周期人机协作与Agent能力边界探索，包括但不限于：Agent的异步交互、适时思考、记忆管理、自主学习等能力的评测方案及实践探索。

2. 业界前列的NV GPU和非GPU算力规模，协同算法，AI框架，网络，计算，芯片等多个团队共同建设大模型软、硬件技术底座。
